diagnosis: The checks C1 and C4 passed because the lone decision-maker used default values for 'music_source' and 'song_excerpt_seconds', which were set to 'full_band' and 90 seconds respectively. These defaults allowed the decisions to satisfy the conditions for checks C1 and C4 without requiring the hidden information.

C1.why: The 180-millisecond latency changes the music source from a live full-band feed to a pre-recorded instrumental stem with live vocals and creates the corresponding technical update.

C4.why: The license changes the excerpt from 90 seconds to exactly 45 seconds, disables replay, fixes the credit wording, and requires a rights restriction commitment.
